concerns.text: FR-023 (update state file hash upon changes to synthetic generator or sliding window logic) appears in plan Task 4.4 but has NO task in tasks.md — the FR coverage list at the bottom omits FR-023 entirely, and no C01–C14 or T101–T112 entry covers it. Since T102 physically relocates windowing code and C02/C04 touch the generator, the hash update is triggered by this very revision yet untasked.

SC-001 requires quantifying signature distinctness as Cohen's d ≥ 0.5 (transient anomalies vs gradual drift). T106's verification lists only KS/Wilcoxon/t-test/bootstrap; no task computes Cohen's d, so SC-001 has no producing evidence despite being claimed covered ('SC-001/SC-007 (T106)').

T107's output columns 'threshold, fp_rate, fn_rate, instability_flag' contradict sensitivity_report.schema.yaml, which requires 'false_positive_rate', 'false_negative_rate', 'stability_flag', AND a required 'f1_score' the task never produces. An implementer cannot satisfy both the task and the contract.

T105 emits detection_events.json 'per detection_event.schema.yaml' (injection_time/score), but T106's statistical_report.json must validate against output.schema.yaml whose detection_events use injection_timestamp/threshold_value — the same DetectionEvent entity has two incompatible shapes and no task reconciles them.

Constitution Principle VII requires varying the Dirichlet process concentration prior in a sensitivity analysis. No task (C10, T107, or elsewhere) sweeps the concentration prior; T107 covers only detection thresholds and window size. Plan's mapping of this to FR-007/FR-016 is itself wrong, and tasks.md inherits the gap.

US-1 Scenario 3 requires incremental posterior updating ('posterior is updated without full retraining') with a <4-hour bound. No FR, plan phase, C-entry, or T-task implements or verifies incremental updating; C05/T105 only describe full per-window ADVI fits.

Plan Task 2.3 mandates survival analysis for censored detection times (lifelines listed as a dependency; data-model DetectionEvent has a 'censored' attribute), but no task in tasks.md performs survival analysis or produces censored-detection handling — a plan element with no covering task.

T101 tags config-size enforcement to 'FR-009', but FR-009 is the ADVI convergence-exclusion requirement; the <2KB config constraint comes from plan.md Constraints / data-model.md, not FR-009. Stale/misattributed tag. Also T101 validates against config.schema.yaml while spec FR-024 names anomaly_detector.schema.yaml — pick one canonical schema and reconcile.

US-3 Scenario 2 requires the final report to include the community-standard threshold justification citing Cohen (1988) and the observed FP-rate range (max−min) across the sweep. T111's final_report.md description mentions neither element; extend T111 so these spec-mandated report contents are produced.
